title: Insurance Claim Services Write-Off Desk Note: Duplicate-Line Credits
content:
A duplicate line credit on a Water Damage Mitigation job enters the Insurance Claim Services credited-line write-off according to when the estimate was submitted against the water job's drying complete and invoiced dates.

**Rule.** The duplicate-line credits are narrowed as follows: when the estimate was submitted on or before the water job's drying complete date, none, because the scope sheet that estimate was built from carries no duplicate; when it was submitted after the drying complete date but before the invoiced date, only the duplicate line credits equal to the water job tier's moisture mapping fee, because moisture mapping is booked once per job from the job's set-day record, which that estimate copied together with any double-keyed entry, while every other line it took from the scope sheet and the daily log; otherwise every duplicate line credit posted on the job, because an estimate built from the invoice carried the duplicated line.

The moisture mapping fee of the water job's tier is 145.00 on the Standard Loss tiers and 245.00 on the Large Loss tiers of Water Damage Mitigation; a credit counts in the middle period only when its amount equals that fee exactly.

## Points of judgement

- Estimate on the drying complete date itself: none.
- Estimate between the two dates on a Black Water Mitigation - Large Loss job with duplicate line credits of 245.00 and 62.50: 245.00 counts, 62.50 does not.
- Estimate on the invoiced date or later: every duplicate line credit on the job counts.
